$comment: UAT fixture for ARAWN-I-0057 (local filesystem feed). Seeds the filesystem_signals projection with synthetic transcript files as if a `filesystem/folder` feed had scanned a notes folder. Distinctive named entities let the judge verify a feed_search round-trip surfaces content that exists ONLY in the transcripts. Absolute timestamps keep behavior stable across CI runs.

lenses.name: notes
lenses.description: Pat's local transcript drop — meeting notes exported to a watched folder and indexed by the filesystem/folder feed.

rows.body_text:
Project Falcon standup — 2026-05-20.
Attendees: Dana Whitfield, Marcus Liang, Priya Raman.
Decision: migrate the ledger service from MySQL to Postgres 16, target cutover the last week of Q3. Dana Whitfield owns the migration plan.
Blocker: the Calidor billing API enforces a 40 requests/second rate limit, so the backfill has to be throttled. Marcus to file a quota-increase ticket.
Codename for the dual-write phase: Operation Bluefin.

Falcon architecture review — 2026-05-22.
The Postgres-for-ledger decision was confirmed; no dissent. Priya Raman raised that Operation Bluefin (the dual-write phase) must run for a minimum of two weeks before we flip reads. Agreed: reads flip only after a clean two-week dual-write window with zero reconciliation drift.
Saturday grocery run: oat milk, sourdough, tomatoes, coffee beans, dish soap. Nothing to do with work.
